title: IJP German-Dutch Programme
description: A reciprocal journalist exchange fellowship run by IJP (Internationale Journalisten-Programme): each year, up to six Dutch journalists work for six to eight weeks at a German newsroom of their choice, and up to six German journalists work at a Dutch newsroom, researching stories for their home outlet while gaining an intensive impression of the host country's media, politics, economy, and culture. Open to working print, radio, and TV journalists (staff or freelance) who regularly contribute to German or Dutch media -- applicants must be German or Dutch nationals. The programme begins with a compulsory language course, followed by a multi-day introductory conference in The Hague covering the host country's press landscape and political culture. Each fellow receives a one-time stipend payment of EUR 3,500 intended to cover most travel, board, and lodging costs; it is a lump sum rather than separately arranged flights or housing, so participants manage their own travel and accommodation with it and are expected to contribute toward remaining costs. Application deadline for the 2027 cohort is October 4, 2026.
visaNote: This is a journalist exchange fellowship, not employment; German and Dutch nationals do not need a visa to work in each other's country under EU freedom of movement.
